annotations.title: Gold Hub: live gold, its market value and where the money goes when gold is sold

description: The OwlChart Gold Hub in one tool (v5.890): what=market (gold futures GC=F and spot XAU/USD, change against yesterday's close, day high and low, the highest trade and its date, 7 day, 30 day, 1 year and year to date moves, gold/silver, market open or closed, the gold miners and the PAXG and XAUT premium), brief (the facts, the strings the page prints, a plain read, the headline), rotation (days=90 or 30: for the dollar, yields, T-bills, bonds, metals, oil, stocks, crypto and the VIX, today's move, the average move and the share of days it rose on the days gold fell hard, a plain label RECEIVING, SOLD WITH GOLD or NEUTRAL, the 30 and 90 day correlation word, today's ranked receivers and the markets sold together with gold), flows (tokenised gold PAXG and XAUT supply and the day's mint or burn read from the Ethereum contracts, CFTC managed money net long in COMEX gold, spot Bitcoin fund flows, stablecoins issued or redeemed, the central bank figure when entered), ratios (gold/silver, ounces of gold per Bitcoin, gold/S&P 500, gold/oil, gold/copper, each with its five year range), value (all the gold above ground in dollars, the change today, from the 90 day high, this year and from the highest trade, against Bitcoin, all crypto and US M2), rates (US 10 year yield, the 10 year real yield from treasury.gov, the dollar index, the next Fed meeting and odds) or news (gold, Fed, dollar and central bank headlines). Moving together is not proof that money moved from one market to another. Page: owlchart.com/gold.html. Data, not advice.

what.description: which gold data set, default brief
